title: PhiloBERTA: A Transformer-Based Cross-Lingual Analysis of Greek and Latin Lexicons
reasoning: The paper performs a philological and computational analysis of Ancient Greek and Latin terms related to theology, epistemology, and ethics (such as logos, anima, iustitia, and episteme). It specifically compares model performance on philosophical texts versus religious (biblical) corpora, evaluating how well the model represents these specialized conceptual domains.
